locations.note: The Run starts in San Francisco, Jack Rourke racing out of the city and down the coast.
Through Death Valley on the way to Las Vegas, where Jack is ambushed.
Las Vegas, the Strip at night, the first big city checkpoint.
Over Independence Pass and the Colorado Rockies in snow.
Denver, where the Camaro is swapped for a GT-R and the Mob closes in.
Chicago, with a race through the city's elevated-rail streets.
The finish in New York: the last sprint into Manhattan.

routes.name: The Run, San Francisco to New York
routes.note: The cross-country race, west to east.
